items.title: Cabo Frio (RJ) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #002
items.en_title: Cabo Frio (RJ) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #002
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Cabo Frio (RJ) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,629,897.39; proposals close Dec 1, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
